'''Kallie Calwell''', was the daughter of [[Dannar Calwell|Dannar]] and [[Annileen Calwell]], two [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|Merchants]] of the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]]. She was also the sister of [[Jabe Calwell]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
At the age of nine Kallie was entrusted to take care of the Calwell family [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]].

===Meeting Kenobi===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] Kallie was still working with her family's dewbacks. While on a dewback named Snit the animal stampeded and headed towards [[the Rumbles]] which contained one of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlaccs]].
Her mother [[Annileen Calwell|Annileen]] attempted a rescue. This was when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] appeared to help the teenager before they fell into the pit of the sarlacc.

Kenobi saved Kallie and Annileen but the dewback [[Snit (dewback)|Snit]] was killed by the sarlacc. Annileen who had been knocked out when Kenobi threw her off the back of the dewback with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and told Kallie that the money to replace the dewback would come out of her wages.

After the incident Kallie told stories of the event to others at the Pika Oasis.

Three days later Kenobi visited the Oasis to buy feed for his [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]], [[Rooh]]. Kallie was tasked to collect the feed while her mother took Kenobi on a tour of the store. When Kallie reentered the building she attacked [[Veeka Gault]] and later followed her mother to watch Kenobi leave.

She later attended the [[Comet Run Podrace]] at [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].
